macos_setup.security_description: Since the application is not signed with an Apple developer certificate, you might see a message saying it cannot be opened. Here is how to resolve it:
macos_setup.step_1: Download the .dmg file of the latest version
macos_setup.step_2: Double-click the downloaded file to mount the disk image
macos_setup.step_3: Drag the application to the Applications folder
macos_setup.step_4: To open the application for the first time, right-click on the application and select 'Open' from the context menu
macos_setup.step_5: Confirm that you want to open the application when the warning window appears
